args.sql:
WITH interference_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry, 
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'Low' THEN 0.25
                ELSE 0
            END + 
            CASE 
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Severe' THEN 1
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Moderate' THEN 0.5
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Minimal' THEN 0.25
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS interference_score
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    JOIN 
        signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    GROUP BY 
        t.telescregistry
),
telescope_updates AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN isc.interference_score > 0.5 THEN 'High Interference' 
            ELSE t.equipstatus 
        END AS new_equipstatus
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    LEFT JOIN 
        interference_scores isc ON t.telescregistry = isc.telescregistry
)
SELECT * FROM telescope_updates;

The interference score for each telescope was calculated by averaging the interference level and atmospheric interference values for each telescope. If the score exceeded 0.5, the telescope's equipment status was updated to "High Interference".

events.sql:
WITH interference_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry, 
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'Low' THEN 0.25
                ELSE 0
            END + 
            CASE 
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Severe' THEN 1
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Moderate' THEN 0.5
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Minimal' THEN 0.25
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS interference_score
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    JOIN 
        signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    GROUP BY 
        t.telescregistry
),
telescope_updates AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN isc.interference_score > 0.5 THEN 'High Interference' 
            ELSE t.equipstatus 
        END AS new_equipstatus
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    LEFT JOIN 
        interference_scores isc ON t.telescregistry = isc.telescregistry
)
SELECT * FROM telescope_updates;
